pendingDecision.reason: The recovery objective is unresolved and lacks executable verification. Launching a replacement worker would exceed the trusted one-agent transaction limit and cannot rely on the prior launch authorization. The smallest legal next action is therefore to request a narrowly scoped budget override rather than retrying automatically, accepting the workstream, or starting Wave 2.

authority.reason: A replacement Cursor worker would exceed maxCursorAgentsPerTransaction=1. Radio expressly requires human approval for a budget override, and prior worker-launch authority is not fresh authority for another agent.

evidenceBasis.summary: The trusted transaction is REVIEWING, has no active agent, permits transition to READY_FOR_HUMAN, and has a one-agent transaction limit with zero remediation budget.
Schema-invalid raw report states that no changes were made because shell and write capabilities were blocked and returns the authorized terminal verdict BLOCKED.
The worker reports that all substantive test, build, deterministic, and browser-verification commands were not run.
Browser verification was reportedly not run, no artifacts were produced, and no evidence was bound to a final executable.
The single permitted Cursor-agent slot was used by the completed trusted execution.
Human approval is required before exceeding the trusted transaction budget.

blockers.summary: The worker reports that shell and write capabilities were unavailable, so it could not implement or verify the authorized recovery. The exact control-plane cause is not independently validated.
No passing deterministic or browser verification establishes that UX-028 false-positive certification now fails closed; the worker reports that known geometry and D2/E2 proof gaps remain.
No recovered final executable or current-SHA-bound browser evidence was produced; the worker reports existing evidence is tied to an older SHA.
The trusted maximum of one Cursor agent per transaction has been reached, so another worker cannot be launched without a human-approved budget override and fresh work-order authority.

stateTransition.reason: The recovery cannot continue autonomously because a replacement worker requires a budget override and fresh authority.

humanApproval.summary: Authorize one replacement ordinary recovery worker after the first worker produced no changes or verification because of a reported execution-capability failure.
humanApproval.requestedAction: Approve increasing maxCursorAgentsPerTransaction from 1 to 2 for this transaction and authorize Radio to issue a fresh work order for one replacement ordinary RECOVERY agent, pinned to f91628706e915f02bf9d258679195765386ea3a8 and limited to the existing Cyber Assurance Wave 1 UX-028 verification-integrity recovery scope. Keep maxRemediationPasses at 0 and retain all prohibitions on Wave 2, Failure Controller changes, PR merge, deployment, and Radio changes.
